title: Not a defect: the progress file is replaced atomically
observed_at_discovery: wizard.save() writes a sibling .tmp and os.replace()s it, so an interruption mid-write leaves the previous complete file. Verified no .tmp is left behind and the second write is visible whole. Separately noted, not filed: load() swallows a decode error and returns {}, which silently restarts the interview rather than losing the config.
